digest.component_or_area: LLM prompt caching and cache breakpoint placement
propositions: Prompt cache breakpoint placement after pass-specific stance suffix prevents cross-pass reads within a single plan-review run despite byte-identical shared plan prefix.

Plan text embedded in marked prefix prevents content-addressed cache reuse across different tickets by design, making cross-ticket prefix identity unsatisfiable without destroying within-run container reuse.
Single-call per-pass plan-review gate pays premium-rate cache-write tokens on every call with zero cross-run benefit because same-ticket re-reviews within TTL occur rarely in practice.
Cache breakpoint must move to end of byte-stable shared_plan_prefix boundary so Pass-1 finder write is read by Pass-2 verifier and same-ticket re-reviews read within TTL.
Write-every-call/read-zero run shape is invisible to existing telemetry (warn_if_cache_ineffective only fires on write==0 AND read==0) and needs dedicated detector.
